boundary_condition: This applies only to airline choice during flight search and does not imply any reusable preference about destination, travel date, route, fare, or departure time. It is not an exclusive-Continental-only rule because some cited requests list Continental alongside Delta and United.
condition: When the synthetic user is searching for flights and an airline preference or carrier filter is being set, but no trip-specific carrier constraint has already been imposed.
default_action: Include Continental Airlines in the acceptable airline options; treat it as a valid preferred carrier rather than leaving the airline unrestricted or requiring only another carrier.
exception_condition: If Continental Airlines is unavailable for the requested itinerary, or the current task explicitly requires a different carrier, do not force Continental; use the task-specific airline constraint instead.
name: Continental-inclusive airline filter
preference_value: Continental Airlines as an acceptable flight carrier
rationale: Across three independent flight instruction_ids, Continental Airlines is repeatedly specified as a desired or acceptable carrier. Two examples include it among multiple acceptable carriers, while one asks for Continental directly, so the coherent synthetic habit is to include Continental as an acceptable preferred carrier, not to require it exclusively.

source_evidence.contribution: User says, "I'm looking to fly Delta, United, or Continental Airlines," supporting Continental as one acceptable carrier among preferred options.
User says, "I'm looking at Continental Airlines," supporting direct selection of Continental as the carrier for that flight search.
User says, "I'm looking to fly through Delta, United or Continental airlines," again supporting Continental as an acceptable carrier option.

source_examples.user_utterance: I'm looking to fly Delta, United, or Continental Airlines. And also the flight out, I'm hoping that it can be sometime in the morning between 9:00 A.M. and 12:00 P.M. noon.
I'm looking at Continental Airlines flying to Seattle on March 5th.
And I'm looking to fly through Delta, United or Continental airlines.
